text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B, D and E for gains felt rewarding, but I should not let that satisfaction drive decisions; assess each sale by its role in the overall portfolio.","My later purchases of B, D and E at higher prices remind me not to buy back simply because I sold earlier or because prices have risen; require a clear investment rationale.","A short run of gains or losses does not predict what comes next. Since prices move randomly and I trade infrequently, avoid reacting to recent account changes without a sound reason."]}
